theorem.name: HRadialNormLawAndValueSourceCutsetTheorem
theorem.statement: After the selected s_beta angle, trace-free quotient, T3 orientation, and q79 lens-circle +i phase are fixed, the Huv matrix is a selected Herm(2) ray.  The radial law is now derived: H_tf(r)=r [[sqrt(s_beta), i sqrt(1-s_beta)],[-i sqrt(1-s_beta), -sqrt(s_beta)]], with r=sqrt(Tr(H_tf^2)/2)=||H_tf||_F/sqrt(2).  The current selected ledger does not emit the numeric ray length. The three legal value-source routes -- typed HRG/R_H^RG map, H/lambda K_threshold row, and determinant/RG radial operator -- all still accept zero numeric value rows.
